TypeParameters.Name: Description
TypeParameters.Value:
Altech Ball Valves AL 3600. Used for heating, cooling and air systems. With full bore and female thread, made of chrome-plated brass with steel handle, grafoil packing, chromium plated brass ball and blow-out proof stem. 

May be used for Group 1 and 2 fluids (liquids and gases), according to AFS 2016: 1, the regulations for pressure equipment. RISE Type Approval No: SC0592-16. Ball valves within the dimension DN40-DN80 are CE-marked according to PED 2014/68/EU
